text:
Maria (partnerships): Looping everyone — Orbit (channel partner) wants a joint co-sell POC for embedded search + chat. High-level asks: shared tenant access, SSO, traffic shaping, and a simple pricing split. Who can lead tech presales?
Nina (acct exec): I'll lead commercial. Need a clear pricing band and rev-share options. Quick Q: can we meter by token and also provide a session-based cap? Orbit requests an SLA for the dedicated pool during the POC.
Aj (sales-eng): I can take tech lead for presales. Need to confirm model variant and deployment mode (hosted vs on-prem). Proposal: Hosted Dedicated with a virtual partner tenant + canary routing for initial traffic.
Lee (solutions-arch): Architecture sketch in one line: Orbit App -> Partner Proxy -> Redwood ingress (partner-route) -> partner-dedicated model pool. SSO: SAML + SCIM for user provisioning. Networking: Orbit will need our outbound IP allowlist for callbacks/webhooks.
Evan (security): Flagging security items: data residency, logs retention, and KV cache persistence. For the POC we should disable analytics and avoid persisting KV cache to disk. Need to provide Orbit our SOC2 summary and encryption details. Also confirm whether Orbit requires BYOK.
Maria (partnerships): Adding: Orbit sent a security questionnaire and initial pricing expectation: ~$0.004/token equivalent for trial months. They want a 3-month ramp. Questionnaire link: https://1password.com/shared/questionnaire-orbit (placeholder).
Aj (sales-eng): For cost control during the POC we can run quantized model variant + aggressive prefix/KV caching. Recommend a nightly cost report and per-tenant usage dashboard. We can support token-based billing and a session cap.
Lee (solutions-arch): Ops runbook snippet to include in the POC: if error rate >5% sustained for 10m, route traffic to fallback model variant and open incident in #eng-oncall. Canary policy: 10% traffic for first 48h, then 50% for next 72h before full ramp.
Nina (acct exec): Legal is asking about IP and analytics. Orbit wants access to logs for product metrics. We should offer aggregated telemetry only and propose a DPA with explicit data-sharing limits.
Evan (security): Confirming BYOK support: we offer KMS integration for Dedicated/Private. For hosted trials we can offer tenant-level encryption keys but BYOK requires Private or Dedicated with enterprise add-on. I'll document options in the questionnaire.
Maria (partnerships): Action items: Aj — produce a one-page POC architecture diagram + cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. Evan — populate the security questionnaire answers by EOD. Nina — draft the commercial term email and suggested rev-share grid. Lee — draft the operational runbook and rollback steps.
Aj (sales-eng): On it. I'll upload the diagram to this thread and post the vector of estimated cost ranges.
provision-bot: sandbox-provisioner: POC sandbox created: pool-id pool-pt-453, creds stored in 1Password (orbit/poc-453). Endpoint: https://poc-453.rwd.inference.example
Maria (partnerships): Great, thanks. I'll schedule a tech kickoff with Orbit for Tuesday 09:00 PT. Please mark items you own and add any blockers. :thumbsup:
Lee (solutions-arch): Noted. I'll add rollback play for model routing and a step to rotate credentials after POC end.
Evan (security): One more: require contract clause to prohibit using POC data to retrain external models. I'll add that to the questionnaire answers.
Nina (acct exec): Thanks team — I'll sync with Orbit on the $0.004/token ask and propose a trial commit with a step-down pricing after month 1.
Maria (partnerships): Closing note: keep updates short here. We'll convert runbook + diagram into the shared handoff doc after the tech kickoff.
